WITH female_adms AS (
  SELECT
    a.subject_id,
    a.hadm_id
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
      ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
  WHERE
    p.gender = 'F'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 86 AND 96
),
mech_counts AS (
  SELECT
    fa.subject_id,
    fa.hadm_id,
    -- count distinct procedure codes per hospitalization that match mechanical circulatory support keywords
    COALESCE(
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%extracorporeal%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%ecmo%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%intra-aortic%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%balloon pump%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%ventricular assist%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%left ventricular assist%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%lvad%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%cardiac assist%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%mechanical circulatory%'
        THEN proc.icd_code
        ELSE NULL
      END), 0) AS mech_proc_distinct_count
  FROM
    female_adms fa
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.procedures_icd` proc
      ON fa.hadm_id = proc.hadm_id
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.d_icd_procedures` d
      ON proc.icd_code = d.icd_code
      AND proc.icd_version = d.icd_version
  GROUP BY
    fa.subject_id,
    fa.hadm_id
)
-- compute approximate 25th and 75th percentiles and IQR
SELECT
  quantiles[OFFSET(25)] AS q1_25pct,
  quantiles[OFFSET(75)] AS q3_75pct,
  quantiles[OFFSET(75)] - quantiles[OFFSET(25)] AS iqr_25_75,
  COUNT(*) AS n_hospitalizations
FROM (
  SELECT
    APPROX_QUANTILES(mech_proc_distinct_count, 100) AS quantiles
  FROM mech_counts
)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  quantiles[OFFSET(25)] AS q1_25pct,
  quantiles[OFFSET(75)] AS q3_75pct,
  quantiles[OFFSET(75)] - quantiles[OFFSET(25)] AS iqr_25_75,
  total_hospitalizations AS n_hospitalizations
FROM (
  SELECT
    APPROX_QUANTILES(mech_proc_distinct_count, 100) AS quantiles,
    COUNT(*) AS total_hospitalizations
  FROM (
    SELECT
      a.subject_id,
      a.hadm_id,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
        WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%extracorporeal%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%ecmo%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%intra-aortic%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%balloon pump%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%ventricular assist%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%left ventricular assist%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%lvad%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%cardiac assist%'
          OR LOWER(COALESCE(d.long_title, '')) LIKE '%mechanical circulatory%'
        THEN proc.icd_code
        ELSE NULL
      END) AS mech_proc_distinct_count
    FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
      ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.procedures_icd` proc
      ON a.hadm_id = proc.hadm_id
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.d_icd_procedures` d
      ON proc.icd_code = d.icd_code
      AND proc.icd_version = d.icd_version
    WHERE
      p.gender = 'F'
      AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 86 AND 96
    GROUP BY
      a.subject_id,
      a.hadm_id
  )
)
LIMIT 1;
